observations.name: writer_assignments
observations.known_limitations: Counts assignments, not effort, messages, or work quality.

observations.name: reviewer_assignments
observations.derivation: Count of declared independent reviewer records.
observations.known_limitations: Does not measure review depth or quality.

observations.name: human_checkpoints
observations.derivation: Count of P2 human checkpoints created through the pending acceptance boundary.
observations.known_limitations: The checkpoint is pending and does not imply acceptance.

observations.name: correction_cycles
observations.derivation: One consolidated implementation, test, and documentation correction cycle followed the single independent review.
observations.known_limitations: Counts the bounded cycle, not individual edits or effort.

observations.name: replay_cycles
observations.derivation: One ordinary R1/E1 replay and the single permitted replacement R2/E2 replay.
observations.known_limitations: R2 predates the final root single-backslash correction and omits ancillary corrected status/catalog documents; final deterministic validation covers current files without a third replay.

observations.name: fresh_session_reconstructions
observations.derivation: Five distinct fresh-context project-agent assignments: architecture reconciliation, implementation, verification, documentation, and consolidated review.
observations.known_limitations: Resumed correction turns reused those sessions and are not counted again.

observations.name: durable_state_recoveries
observations.derivation: The implementation writer timed out with partial durable files and was resumed to complete source/schema work.
observations.known_limitations: Counts one operational recovery, not ordinary task resumption or review correction.

observations.name: material_failures_prevented_or_recovered_before_acceptance
observations.derivation: One observed implementation timeout was recovered and one consolidated review exposed material contract defects before the pending acceptance boundary.
observations.known_limitations: This is an observable event count only; it does not infer causality, cost, productivity, or how many downstream failures would have occurred.
